name: archive.org paippalAda-shAkhA
reason: WRONG_RECENSION. Title and description say Atharvaveda paippalAda-shAkhA explicitly. 54 audio files, 90.59 h -- the largest Atharvavedic audio item on the Archive, and the recension trap in its purest form. Its filenames use vedamu's {id}$name scheme (421$Kanda1.mp3), so it is also an unauthorised mirror of a reference-only source. Not mapped anywhere in this artifact.

name: archive.org Atharvaveda-shaunaka-shAkhA
reason: Correct recension on its own title, but 22 audio files for 5,839 mantras (38.94 h, roughly 2 h per file) with no cue index, no printed timestamps and no chapter index, so no mantra boundary is establishable. Same uploader and same vedamu {id}$name filename scheme as the Paippalada item above, so it is an unauthorised mirror of a source whose operator states it is open to listen and not to download.

name: archive.org IISH_Atharva_Veda
reason: 28 files, 19.20 h, courtesy www.iish.org (Indian Institute of Scientific Heritage, Dr N. Gopalakrishnan). Per-part monolithic (AV001.mp3 onwards), no cue index, no per-mantra boundary. Its 28 durations are identical to those of atharvaveda_202107, so the two items are one master.

licence: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/ (applied by the uploader, not the rights holder)
name: archive.org atharvaveda_202107
reason: Carries a CC0 Public Domain Mark 1.0 and credits Veda Prasara Samithi, but its 28 files have durations identical to IISH_Atharva_Veda's (2410.4, 2686.6, 2535.8, 2672.1 ...), which is published as the IISH master. The Public Domain Mark is applied by a third-party uploader over a differently-attributed creator, so the licence statement is not a rights clearance. Per-part monolithic in any case.

name: archive.org atharvaved-tune
reason: 21 files, 18.64 h, one per kanda. No licence statement, no reciter, no cue index. A whole kanda is not a mantra and the campaign forbids attaching a long recording to an exact mantra without verified boundaries.

name: archive.org AtharvaVeda1-40 and siblings
reason: 189 tracks of about 10 minutes across four items (1-40, 41-90, 91-150, 151-189). No licence, no creator, no reciter, and no index saying which mantras a track holds, so 189 tracks cannot be resolved onto 5,839 mantras.

name: archive.org AtharvaVedam
reason: 44 audio files, 59.58 h, named Kandam 01 to Kandam 21 -- one more than the twenty kandas the Saunaka samhita has, which is itself unexplained. No licence, no reciter, per-kanda granularity.

name: archive.org atharvaveda1 / atharvaveda2
reason: 20 files of about 46 minutes each, no licence, no reciter, no index. Per-file granularity is roughly 300 mantras.

name: Wikimedia Commons
reason: 80 audio results for Atharvaveda in the File namespace and 68 for 'atharva veda recitation'. None is Atharvavedic recitation: they are Samavedic gana, Rigvedic sastra recordings and dictionary pronunciations of the word 'Veda'.

name: Vedic Heritage Portal (IGNCA)
reason: PERMISSION_REQUIRED and no credited reciter, so no resolvable consent chain. The route was already removed from this product by a prior decision and was not re-probed in this wave.
